walkthrough: Goal: V大's week 3, solids in boxes: never draw a cylinder straight off, draw the box first and find the solid in it by 点定位; then see the exact solid over my drawing and judge my copy against it by eye: nothing of my strokes is read (S145).
Entry: lessons of Solids from the home: at level 1 two cylinders, at level 2 two cones, at level 3 a sphere and a cylinder or a cone in turn.

Cylinder: a lesson of Solids at level 1; the cylinder's How shows first. Title: A cylinder in its box; Week 3 · a cylinder found in its box: the box first, never the cylinder straight off. The example plays at a hand's pace: an end's diagonals in pencil, the lines through their crossing towards the vanishing points with the four middles dotted, the ellipse in ink through them, the other end alike, two sides touching both ellipses; then Compare: the exact cylinder in see-through red over the hand's ink, the far end's hidden half dashed. Steps: 1 An end's diagonals: its centre, 2 Through it towards the vanishing points: the four middles, 3 The ellipse through the middles with Draw, touching the edges, 4 The other end alike, 5 Two straight lines touching both ellipses, 6 Compare. One paragraph says how to practise: ghost each ellipse and side, draw it once, the far end's hidden half too, redraw a wrong one once with Correct. Got it.

The exercise: the left frame and mine each hold the same box in ink as the eye sees it, whole, its hidden edges dashed, its horizon labelled; here a cylinder lying along the left direction, its square ends facing left and right. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo. With Sketch I cross the near end's diagonals; with Draw I draw its ellipse through the middles but too flat (a mistake), the far end's ellipse whole (its hidden half too), and two sides along the ends.

Compare: the exact cylinder in red as thick as my pen and see-through over my ink, the far end's hidden half dashed; my near end visibly flatter than the red; nothing of mine is read, ringed or run on. The left frame now shows V大's construction in dashed pencil, both ends' diagonals and the lines through their centres with the middles dotted, and the cylinder in ink, inside its frame. The card: Construction, How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again. The pen is blue (Correct): I draw the near end again through the middles and Compare: my correction on the red. I choose Almost, kept with the exercise once; no number is kept.

Home leaves the cylinders' lesson under way. Cone, a lesson of Solids at level 2: its How plays (the base's diagonals, middles and ellipse; the opposite face's diagonals crossing at the point; two lines from the point touching the base; Compare). A cone lying on its side in its box: with Sketch the opposite face's diagonals for the point; with Draw the base's ellipse and two sides from the point touching it. Compare: the exact cone red over mine, the base's hidden part dashed; I choose Again.

Sphere, a lesson of Solids at level 3: its How plays (the box halved in height through its side faces' diagonals, the middle section with its diagonals and middles, its ellipse with Sketch, a circle with Draw through the ends of the ellipse's long axis; Compare). A cube seen from below: with Sketch the middle section's diagonals; with Draw V大's circle. Compare: the exact outline red over my circle, within a pen's width of it: V大's circle is near in the views the cubes are laid in; I choose Accurate. Next: Solids 2/2, the solid beside it.
Undo and Redo: the correction undone and redone like any stroke, the sheet as it was; the comparison is the screen's, never the artwork's.

In Chinese (s93-solids-zh, this walk-through run as on a Chinese tablet): 圆柱, 圆锥, 球体; 盒子里的圆柱, 第 3 周 · 在盒子里找圆柱：先画盒子，不要直接画圆柱。; 1 对角线找端面中心, 2 过中心连向消失点，得四边中点, 3 过四个中点画椭圆，切于四边, 4 另一端同样, 5 两条直线同时切两个椭圆, 6 叠图对比; the steps and the canvas's hashes are this run's.
